title: Uesugi Shrine
geometryBasis: OpenStreetMap building and fence geometry, named shrine and torii points, and native GSI elevation. January 2024 photographs show the courtyard gate, torii and worship-hall frontage.
sectionBasis: The worship hall has a broad gray-green hipped roof with raised corners and a high ridge, dark natural timber framing and open central bays. The entrance is much lower and links the timber enclosure. The stone torii has two inward-sloping pillars and a curved upper lintel.
limitations: The model depicts the standing shrine buildings, enclosure and torii. The demolished castle buildings, outer moat, treasure hall and separate Matsugasaki Shrine are outside its scope.
Roof heights, rear-facing finish details and hand-carved fittings are approximate. The entrance is presented without seasonal crowds, snow, temporary decorations or inscriptions.
